reproduction.scope: Disposable nonshipping QA build with local debug-fallback signing and embedded release bundle; keep normal memory admission.
steps: Open a chat, select QA Stage 7 (chat-qa-stage7-panel-toggle), then QA diagnostic frontend A/B (not acceptance) (chat-qa-stage7-phonemizer-diagnostic).

This invokes runAndroidQaStage7Voices(phonemizer_diagnostic). On this source it runs canonical-reference/production-target, then builtin-reference/canonical-target, using the pinned profile and fixed configuration above. The QA path prepares and validates its pinned base/adapter and TTS assets.

At each awaiting_clip_copy gate, read chat-qa-stage7-evidence and retain its clipId. Export cache/tts-clips/clip.wav from the isolated package with the command below using binary-safe output capture; verify size and SHA-256 before continuing.
Press QA continue after host action (chat-qa-stage7-continue) within the 180-second gate. The first clip is cleared before the second arm. Repeat export/continue for the second arm.

Require diagnostic_complete, requiresForceStop=false and successful profile restoration/chat_after. Evaluate each exported clip independently against the fixed target with the pinned content evaluator and WER threshold above. Diagnostic completion alone does not establish content acceptance.
reproduction.exportCommand: adb -s <device-serial> exec-out run-as com.github.tah10n.pocketai.qa cat cache/tts-clips/clip.wav
reproduction.cleanup: After retaining compact hashes and evaluation, delete only owned exported WAVs. The QA sequence clears its temporary clip and restores the prior app model/settings/thread; do not reset shared app data.
reproduction.productionBoundary: The recorded canonical target is selected by this closed QA mode only; arbitrary text and production G2P are not accepted by this diagnostic.
